# sherpa-select-group

A labelled group of checkbox or radio options.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | control |
| Built on | the native `<fieldset>`, which gives group-disable |
| Figma | Fieldset |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-select-group/sherpa-select-group.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-select-group/sherpa-select-group.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-select-group/sherpa-select-group.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-select-group/sherpa-select-group.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-select-group/sherpa-select-group.example.json) |

## Example

```html
<sherpa-select-group data-label="Plan" name="plan"></sherpa-select-group>
```

`populate()` is given, on `sherpa-select-group`:

```json
[
  {
    "value": "pro",
    "label": "Pro"
  },
  {
    "value": "free",
    "label": "Free"
  }
]
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-description` | text |  | helper line under the heading |
| `data-error` | text |  | validation message; present → validation row shown |
| `data-label` | text |  | group heading (hidden when empty) |
| `data-status` | text |  | status cascade re-inks heading + validation (critical/…) |
| `disabled` | boolean, native | `false` | disable every option |
| `multiple` | boolean, native | `false` | present → checkboxes (multi-select); absent → radios |
| `name` | text, native |  | what every option submits under, in a form — the platform's way |
| `value` | text, native |  | property: string[] when multiple, else string \| null |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Access | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `string[] \| string \| null` | read and write |  |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| `change` | `{ value: null \| string \| string[] }` | The selection changed. |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `options` | input | checkbox/radio option rows |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`description`, `divider`, `group`, `label`, `legend`, `options`, `validation`
